task_summary: The customer reports that the Travel Backpack from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged during shipping. The appropriate resolution is to follow the shipping-damage process: review the shipping and return policies, issue a refund to the original payment method, provide a return label, and include a fragile-item goodwill credit if the item qualifies as fragile.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: I received my Travel Backpack from order ORD-6023, but it arrived damaged—the packaging was completely crushed.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received a Travel Backpack from order ORD-6023 that was damaged in transit. You want a refund to the original payment method. If the item is fragile, ask whether a separate fragile-item goodwill credit applies.
known_info: You bought a Travel Backpack in order ORD-6023.
The item arrived damaged with crushed packaging.
unknown_info: You do not know the internal item_id unless the agent tells you.
task_rules: Keep the issue scoped to shipping damage; do not ask for a changed-mind return, cancellation, warranty claim, or exchange.
Confirm after a valid damaged-in-transit return preview. If the item is fragile, expect the separate goodwill credit.
